title: Finish Time of Tasks I
summary: Tasks form a tree rooted at zero, with directed parent-child edges and base durations. A leaf finishes at its base duration. A nonleaf finishes at twice its latest child finish minus its earliest child finish plus its own base duration. Return the root's finish time.
officialConstraints: 1..100000 tasks, exactly n-1 edges forming a valid rooted tree; base durations 1..100000; every finish time is less than 2^53.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
